summary: Case case-002 (prof.kaya@aegean.edu) is assessed benign, confidence 0.75. No surviving findings; all three claims were rejected by the Critic. F1: impossible-travel claim (Manisa→Lisbon, 32 min) rejected—the TR event is a non-interactive ExchangeSync/15 mail-sync token, while Portugal sign-ins used VPN vpn-edge-02 from device LT-3104. F2: 193.140.10.21 failures against 54 accounts are shared-NAT Turkcell background noise, not password spray. F3: vpn-edge-02 firmware 22.7R2.8 includes fixes for cited CISA KEV CVEs (CVE-2025-22457, CVE-2025-0282). No compromise signal survived.

risk.rationale: No surviving verified findings. All three suspicious signals were rejected with reasoned critics: (1) the Manisa→Lisbon 'impossible travel' involved a non-interactive ExchangeSync/15 mail token plus legitimate VPN sign-ins from device LT-3104 via vpn-edge-02; (2) the 193.140.10.21 activity was shared-NAT Turkcell background noise (60/60 failures across many accounts), not a coordinated spray targeting this user; (3) the VPN appliance firmware 22.7R2.8 already contains fixes for the cited CISA KEV CVEs. No data-quality conflicts remain. Suspicious signals are explained away; no confirmed takeover chain, weak unexplained signal, or exposure requiring human review.
